verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is API-first. Its client libraries in multiple languages expose the core functionality (ros2-docs-36, ros2-docs-7), and the `ros2` CLI covers nodes, topics, services, bags and security (ros2-docs-37, ros2-docs-39, ros2-docs-42). The bare-bones install ships communication libraries and CLI tools with no GUI tools at all (ros2-docs-44), and bag recording is available both from the CLI and from a Python API (ros2-docs-17, ros2-docs-23). That suggests nothing core depends on the GUI. missing for 10: an explicit statement or demonstration that GUI tools like RViz have programmatic equivalents, and independent corroboration that the API and CLI match the GUI.
